subject: prd/implement-now
statement: When the parent routing contract's complete pre-release gate is green, `/implement-now` shall activate the validated execution-demand resolver for every supported production implementation path in one switch with no shadow or canary cohort, and shall retire the hardcoded rung/model/effort path only after the direct-cutover and strongest-profile fallback rehearsals pass.
rationale: mixed routing semantics would make production outcomes incomparable and preserve the hardcoded pin indefinitely
fit_criterion: one production configuration covers the complete supported harness/profile implementation domain; inspection finds no cohort logic or reachable hardcoded selection path after activation; cutover and fallback drills pass
